searchText: Hello, My question is maybe very stupid, but well 😇 I wonder how the 21063 deposits that have been made before genesis are stored in the beacon chain? When I query the genesis block via the P2P network (`BeaconBlocksByRange`), `block.body.deposits` is empty... They're baked into the genesis state.

excerpts.author: leruaa
excerpts.content:
Hello,
My question is maybe very stupid, but well 😇 

I wonder how the 21063 deposits that have been made before genesis are stored in the beacon chain? When I query the genesis block via the P2P network (`BeaconBlocksByRange`), `block.body.deposits` is empty...

excerpts.author: tersec
excerpts.content: They're baked into the genesis state.
